title.zh: 混响/延迟可由协议调，声像与发送也能画包络
title.en: Reverb and delay are settable over the protocol, and pan or send lanes can be drawn

highlights.zh: 新增 set_arrangement_effects：按编排覆写混响 decay/damping/preDelay 与延迟 time/feedback/damp/pingPong，部分补丁、越界钳位。总线是实时参数，改动立即生效不切断音符。
highlights.en: A new set_arrangement_effects overrides an arrangement's reverb (decay, damping, preDelay) and delay (time, feedback, damp, pingPong) — a partial patch, clamped. Both buses take live changes, so no note is cut.

highlights.zh: 自动化不再只支持音量：声像、混响/延迟发送都可画包络，各自按本参数的量程显示，轨道头可下拉切换。
highlights.en: Automation is no longer level-only: pan and both sends can be drawn as envelopes, each on its own scale, with a field selector in the track header.
